newsitem.title: USA: Hughes sees Q4 earnings below estimates.
newsitem.headline: Hughes sees Q4 earnings below estimates.

text.p: Hughes Supply Inc said it expects fiscal fourth quarter earnings of $0.60 to $0.65 a share, slightly below Wall Street's expectations.
Wall Street analysts had estimated Hughes earnings at $0.65 to $0.70 a share, Hughes said.

The expected shortfall is primarily attributable to the restatement of earnings related to acquisitions completed during the quarter, which were accounted for under the pooling-of-interests method, the company said.
A slightly lower comparable unit sales gain as compared to previous periods were also a contributing factor, the company said.
Hughes said it plans to report earnings for the fourth quarter ending January 31, 1997 during the week of March 17.
